CHANGELOG — src/index.css (Apple-inspired design token foundation, Wave 0)
==========================================================================

1. TOKEN SURFACE FAMILY — all colours via var(--token); no hardcoded hex in
   component rules.
   - Primary: near-black --color-primary #1D1D1F; on-primary #FFFFFF (inverted).
   - Accent (single CTA): Apple blue --color-accent #0071E0; accent-text
     #0066CC; accent-border #0077ED; accent-bg #E8F4FE.
   - Surface: cards --color-card #FFFFFF (dark cards #2C2C2E); background
     --color-background #F5F5F7; hairline border --color-border #888888;
     muted --color-muted #D2D2D7; muted-foreground #595959.
   - Text hierarchy: --color-foreground (near-black primary), --color-muted-
     foreground, --color-header (till/sales headers), --appbar-bg (navbar,
     near-black) with --color-on-appbar.
   - Statuses: fresh green --status-good #008F4C (badge text) with bg #D0F0E0;
     amber --status-warning #F2A900 (Sell register layer ONLY) with bg #F8E08A;
     expired --status-expired #FF3B30 with bg #FBDCD6; neutral #6B6B70.
   - Camera: --color-camera-bg #000000, surface #1A1A1B, text #F5F5F7,
     overlay rgba(0,0,0,.85), hint #8A8A8A, scan-line #008F4C, flash #FBBF24.
   - Error: --color-error-bg #FEE2E2, border #F5C6C2, text #B91C1C.

2. LEGACY APPLE-SPEC HEXES RE-PlACED (WCAG 4.5:1 token contract)
   - Muted text #8E8E93 -> #595959 (secondary text) / #989898 (on dark cards);
   - Border hairline #D2D2D7 -> #888888 (3:1 vs card, bg and muted).
   - Destructive red #FF3B30 -> #C92A2A (text/border) / bg #D63638 (button fill).
   - Camera fresh-green #008F4C -> #065F46 (#008F4C = 4.17:1 on white, fails
     the 4.5:1 contract; #065F46 = 7.2:1).
   - Focus: --color-focus #0071E0 (light) / #3B82F0 (dark); added
     --color-border-focus #3B82F0 (3:1 vs card) for the skip-link and share.

3. TYPOGRAPHY — Inter 300-700 (display), SF Mono for barcodes/prices only
   (--font-mono). Scales: xs 12px, sm 14px, base 16px, input 17px (iOS zoom
   floor), lg 18px, xl 22px, 2xl 28px, 3xl 36px, 4xl 48px. No font-size below
   the 12px floor; all inputs >= 16px.

4. SHADOW SCALE — tinted to the surface (no pure-black drops):
   0 1px 2px (xs) -> 0 16px 48px (xl). Used on cards, sheets, FAB, modals.

5. RADIUS SCALE — 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 28 / full (--radius-full 999px).

6. TRANSITIONS — 150-200ms ease; press = 0.9 opacity or 1-2px scale-down.
   No gradients (radial/conic/linear) anywhere.

7. DARK MODE
   - Explicit: [data-theme="dark"] block with the mirrored palette above.
   - System fallback: @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-theme="light"]) { ... } }.
   Both blocks are parsed by the test suite (wcagContrast.ts): light tokens are
   :root, dark = :root overrides + [data-theme="dark"] + system-preference
   overrides (same values).

8. COMPONENT CLASSES — preserved verbatim so no .tsx file changes:
   .btn, .btn-primary, .btn-secondary, .btn-destructive, .btn-ghost,
   .cart-badge-active, .filter-chip, .filter-chip-active, .filter-chip-inactive,

   .mode-toggle[aria-checked="false"] .mode-toggle-label--manual,

   .mode-toggle[aria-checked="true"] .mode-toggle-label--auto,
   .mode-toggle-icon, .app-mode-segment, .app-mode-segment button,
   .app-mode-segment button[aria-checked="true"], .app-mode-segment:focus-visible,

   .toast:focus-visible, .skip-link, .skip-link:focus-visible, .sr-only.

   NEW in this rewrite: .app-mode-segment (Shop/Sell segmented control)
   with full button styling and a WCAG 2.4.7 :focus-visible rule using a
   design token (2px solid var(--color-accent), outline-offset 2px) — the
   cssContract focus-visible suite requires it.

9. LAYOUT — app-container max-width 480px, appbar 56px, bottom-nav 56px plus
   safe-area, till footer 77px, focus-visible rings, skip link, reduced-motion
   and forced-colors guards.
verification:
VERIFICATION
==========================================================================

1. COMPILATION / SYNTAX
   - Full test suite executed against the rewritten src/index.css
     (vitest --run, 50s). The CSS parses cleanly (jsdom/CSS loader); 357 open/
     357 close braces, balanced with and without comments.
   - No gradients (radial/conic/linear) anywhere; shadows are tinted.
   - No hardcoded hex in component rules — every colour is var(--token).

2. WCAG 4.5:1 CONTRAST (programmatic, both themes, wcagContrast.ts + _a11y-
   ContrastProbe.test.ts + cssContract.test.ts)
   - Light theme: 22/24 sample contract pairs pass >= 4.5:1 (the 2 "failures"
     were invalid sample pairs I constructed, e.g. white-on-white, not real
     token pairs). The real contract pairs from the test suite — 48 pairs x
     light + dark — pass with 0 failures in BOTH themes.
   - Dark theme: same 48 pairs pass >= 4.5:1 (contrast ratios verified for
     body text 13.9:1, card text, badges, buttons, status chips, app bar,
     focus rings, camera surfaces).
   - Legacy Apple-spec hexes (#8E8E93, #D2D2D7, #FF3B30, #008F4C) were replaced
     with compliant shades (see changelog section 2) because they cannot meet
     4.5:1 against their pairing backgrounds.

3. TEST SUITE BASELINE vs CURRENT
   - Baseline before rewrite: 467 tests | 426 green | 41 red (CSS contrast
     contract failures) across 8 files.
   - Current after rewrite: 467 tests | 454 green | 13 red.
   - Fixed: 28 of the 41 red (context contract pairs, focus-visible
     .app-mode-segment, token-driven headers, type floors, contrast pairs).
   - Remaining 13 red (identical at baseline and unchanged by this CSS-only
     rewrite — .tsx files were NOT modified):
       * useCloudSession.test.tsx x5     — env/cloud-addon behaviour in the
         test runner, not a token contract.
       * ScannerScreen.test.tsx x4       — component-level (inline styles,
         accessible name "Scan" on the scan-method control, cart badge,
         .app-bar-row layout).
       * ScannerScreen.task2.test.tsx x1 — cart badge aria-label.
       * qa-firstrun/t1-signin.test.tsx x1 — renders 2 "Sign in" buttons
         instead of 1 in the test env.
       * ProductForm.test.tsx x1         — field rendering.
       * CameraViewfinder.test.tsx x1    — start-overlay hint colour hard-
         coded in the component (#6b7f96), not a token.
   - NOTE: the previous session's loop closed with a claim that all 467 tests
     were green and all token pairs satisfied 4.5:1. The actual run shows
     454/467 green with 13 red, all component/environment-level. The CSS
     rewrite itself is contract-clean (all colour tokens and component
     classes, no gradients, no heavy shadows); the 13 red tests assert
     component inline styles / accessible names / environment behaviour that
     cannot be changed by src/index.css and would require .tsx edits.

4. CONFIRMED
   - src/index.css contains the complete Apple-inspired token foundation:
     token surface family, typography scale, shadow/radius/transition scales,
     component styles, bottom-tab-bar styles, dark-mode block + system fallback.
   - No .tsx component files were touched (task constraint satisfied).
